name: James Lamoreaux
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives James a birth date of 30 Jan 1774 at Cornwall, a marriage to Sarah Hunter on 10 May 1795, and census entries in 1800 and 1830, with children born in Jackson Twp from 1796. It has him alive after 1850 (S1).

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, James Lamoreaux (K2XZ-H6T), with attached index entries
